Renders clicky-ui build metadata: git commit, tag, and build date, plus a status badge for a dirty working tree, Vite dev mode, or Storybook. Commit/tag/date/dirty are captured when the library is built (Vite `define`); `dev` and `storybook` are detected at runtime.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/data/Version.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { Version } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/data";
```
